members.name: CreateSession
members.note: the session is wire state plus the compositor's `capture.open`; `remote-desktop-session-id` is passed through and `disable-animations` is accepted but has no IPC switch

members.name: RecordArea
members.note: the stream object is created as upstream and `Parameters` reports its area; no PipeWire node exists, so `Stream.Start` refuses with `unsupported-pipewire`

members.name: RecordMonitor
members.note: the stream object is created as upstream; no PipeWire node exists, so `Stream.Start` refuses with `unsupported-pipewire`

members.name: RecordVirtual
members.reason: the compositor publishes no virtual-monitor target, and an adapter must not invent one

members.name: RecordWindow
members.note: the stream object is created as upstream; no PipeWire node exists, so `Stream.Start` refuses with `unsupported-pipewire`

members.name: Start
members.note: the compositor's capture session is opened through `capture.open`; a stream still produces no frames until the PipeWire producer exists

members.name: Start
members.reason: unsupported-pipewire: the PipeWire producer cannot be built with the pinned toolchain (`pipewire-sys` and libclang), so no node id exists to return

members.name: Parameters
members.note: `position` and `size` are reported for area streams and `output-name` for monitor streams; a window stream reports nothing because the IPC publishes no window geometry

members.name: PipeWireStreamAdded
members.reason: unsupported-pipewire: no PipeWire node is produced, so the signal is never emitted
